title: Choose the visual world
question: Redesign home + /demarrer for TWM Advisory. Keep copper and Forward Deployed posture. The roll assigned Open Calibre.

options.label: Open Calibre
options.lineage: Swiss open-heart watch movement — precision made visible
options.thesis: The performance mandate as an open mechanical movement: copper bridges, sapphire clarity, one decisive winding action to book.
options.viewport: Full-bleed dark steel field; giant open-calibre diagram left; TWM claim and copper primary CTA right; no eyebrow pill.
options.risk: Can feel jewelry-luxury if the mechanism stays decorative instead of proving the operating method.

raised.raise: Copper owns large contiguous fields (bridges/sectors), not sprinkle accents.
Maturity stages (diagnose → decide → deliver → measure) read as sequential gear train, not icon cards.
The layout grid is structural metal frames, not nested glass cards.
No enclosure boxes; hierarchy is scale and depth of the mechanism, not borders.
Continuous surface: one movement across the viewport without visible section seams.
Cross-check reading order: claim → proof needles → book action, with amber only for caution states.

options.label: Brass Mandate
options.thesis: The priority is a brass mandate plate: weight, permanence, one copper seal to submit.
options.viewport: Centered heavy brass plate with TWM wordmark cut in; short mandate line; single copper CTA under the seal.
options.risk: Also the direction most DG advisory sites drift toward — familiar and effective.

options.label: Night Six-Pack
options.thesis: Outside is ink; six calm gauges prove the mandate; booking is the cross-check complete.
options.viewport: Two rows of three performance gauges; claim as placard; copper book CTA as master switch.
options.case: Stronger product clarity for measured ops; slightly less boardroom-DG identification than Open Calibre.
options.risk: Reads aviation cosplay if gauges are fake decoration without real score logic.

options.label: Seamless Wave
options.thesis: A hard copper-on-ink wave that never shows a seam; the CTA sits in a calm trough.
options.viewport: Continuous optical wave full bleed; TWM claim locked in still zone; copper pill in trough.
options.case: Wins modernity and seamlessness; loses on proving the operating mechanism.
options.risk: Becomes pure decoration if the wave does not encode priority or progress.

options.label: Color Chord Canopy
options.case: DG does not identify with festival color chords for a performance mandate.
options.kept: Committed color fields that own regions.

options.label: Brine Calendar
options.case: Culinary theater mismatches executive performance trust.

options.label: Elbow Panel
options.case: Sci-fi pastels break DG trust and copper brand.

options.label: Cracktro Queue
options.case: Underground demoscene ID fails for executive acquisition.
options.kept: No boxes; hierarchy by depth and scale only.

canonCard.label: Dark SaaS advisory standard
canonCard.thesis: What AI-advisory marketing usually ships: dark hero, Inter, accent CTA, card grid.
canonCard.viewport: Centered headline, subcopy, dual CTAs, three feature cards below.
